title: Chapter 254: Scary Xu Yin
html:
The face woven from blood vessels seemed to strike an invisible barrier and stopped thirty centimeters from Chen Ge.

“This is?”

The face froze, its blood vessels recoiling. A young man now stood between it and Chen Ge.

“They peeled my skin back, and as the blood fell, I saw how they planned to share me.”

The young man looked barely grown, and tears glistened in his eyes. He slowly raised his head. As his emotions spiraled out of control, blood poured from every orifice. “It hurt. It hurt so much!”

His features twisted and shifted. In a frenzy, he drove his hands into the face on the back of the passenger’s head, then tore at its blood vessels with his teeth like a rabid animal.

The passenger and the face screamed together, and Chen Ge lurched back a full step. This was the first time he had seen Xu Yin manifest in person. Perhaps because of the torment he had endured before death, Xu Yin had become an exceptionally violent specter, as though brutality were his only outlet for a lifetime of pain and resentment.

This is insane.

The scene grew increasingly gruesome, and Chen Ge edged back another step.

Once summoned, he doesn’t hold anything back. That is rather terrifying.

Chen Ge gripped the hammer tightly.

But clinging to all that rage can’t be good for him. I should find some way to counsel him.

Xu Yin was not a Red Specter, so he was weaker than Zhang Ya. In ruthlessness and sheer capacity for violence, however, the young man was even more extreme.

Every specter from the Wheel of Misfortune is unique. I’ll need to be careful from now on.

With the Specter’s Favored title, Chen Ge suspected that the wheel would give him only Baleful Specters or items that increased their affection. Either way, he would end up surrounded by more ghosts.

I may be braver than most, but I’m still only human. Some things shouldn’t be pushed too far.

The passenger writhed on the ground. The face on the back of his head was far stronger than Chen Ge had expected. Xu Yin suffered injuries as well, and his body began to flicker, but the face was in even worse condition. Xu Yin had nearly ripped it free of the passenger’s skull.

“What kind of monster is this?” The face wailed in agony, but no one answered. Its blood vessels continued to disintegrate, while Xu Yin attacked with the abandon of someone longing for death. The sight stirred Chen Ge’s pity.

I shouldn’t summon Xu Yin unless my life is truly at stake.

Chen Ge suddenly missed the Pen Spirit. Of all his employees, she was the gentlest. Cunning though she was, she had never once disobeyed him.

Xu Yin was losing himself to his rage. Chen Ge hurried from his hiding place. Unable to watch the carnage continue, he decided to end the fight as quickly as possible.

Monsters from behind the door need human hosts to survive for long outside it. Doctor Skull-cracker has little effect on the blood face, so I’ll have to target the passenger.

Chen Ge charged the passenger with his hammer raised and swung. I can’t hit his head, so where can I knock him out without killing him?

The passenger heard Chen Ge approaching. Every hair on his body stood on end, and he twisted around, his eyes nearly bulging from their sockets. “I…”

He tried to speak, but Chen Ge gave him no chance. The hammer fell, and bone cracked.

The Ghost Stories Society member collapsed with a broken leg. Knowing it needed a host, the blood face peeled itself away, transformed into a malevolent human head, and fled toward the crematorium. The instant it abandoned the passenger, the man seemed to lose his soul. He crumpled to the ground, his eyes utterly lifeless.

“Chase it!” Before Chen Ge could finish the order, Xu Yin was already moving. The melancholic, artistic-looking young man who had first appeared now wore a hideously twisted expression. Blood streamed from the wounds covering his body as he pursued the human head.

“Don’t kill it! I still have questions!” Chen Ge shouted, but he was too late. Completely out of control, Xu Yin seized the human head and began devouring it. Its piercing screams shook leaves from the trees as it slowly disappeared between Xu Yin’s hands.

After consuming the monster, Xu Yin stood motionless for a long while. The wounds on his body began to heal, but the stains on his shirt did not fade. Once blood covered his clothes completely, he would become the second Red Specter in Chen Ge’s Haunted House.

His arms hanging at his sides, Xu Yin slowly turned his hollow gaze toward Chen Ge. He resembled a man trapped indoors by rain, desperate to leave yet afraid of getting wet. Chen Ge did not know what to say. He could feel the pain and loneliness within Xu Yin.

“I know what happened to you, and I understand your pain, but perhaps you could find another way to release it. You can always talk to me.” Rather than scold Xu Yin, Chen Ge approached and offered his hand. “Perhaps we can be friends.”

He had once said something similar to Zhang Ya. Noticing the change in Xu Yin’s expression, Chen Ge realized the speech might prove useful again.

Xu Yin studied Chen Ge for a long moment. He did not take the offered hand, however, and slowly dissolved into the darkness.

“So painful…”

The tape in the recorder stopped turning, and silence returned to the woods as though everything had been a dream. Chen Ge lifted the unconscious passenger and pulled back his sleeves to examine his arms.

The positions of the cigarette burns confirmed that this was the man from Hai Ming Apartments—No. 5 of the Ghost Stories Society.

After Xu Tong and the patient with phantom limb syndrome died, the black phone notified me that the mission completion rate had increased. No. 5’s monster has been destroyed and he is unconscious, yet the phone hasn’t reacted at all. He probably isn’t a patient from the Third Sick Hall.

Chen Ge began dragging No. 5 from the woods, but after only a few steps, a thought stopped him.

Something is wrong. Given the thin monster’s strength, it shouldn’t have needed to flee from the blood face. Yet according to Wang Shenglong, it sensed a threat and chose to leave.

No. 5 couldn’t have posed that kind of threat, which means…

A sharp light entered Chen Ge’s eyes.

Someone else must have accompanied No. 5 to Hai Ming Apartments!

The surveillance footage had probably captured other members as well, but they had concealed themselves too well to be noticed.

Only a Red Specter could have frightened the thin monster away!
